title: Ambiguity-gate result (pc_check.py --context-gate)
description: Structured result for callers that cannot ask a question (DB workers, batch jobs). status needs_input means: do not generate; route the question to whoever can answer it. Exit 0 for ok, 3 for needs_input.

invalid.description: Supplied values that are not known ids.

question.description: One compact question covering every missing input; empty when status is ok.
